title: HOLD Y NEXT TO A TEAMMATE TO PATCH HIM UP

edits.replacement: function netAidTarget(p,any){   // v16.77: any set skips the facing test (the Y hold); the belt path still faces him

if(code==='KeyQ'&&G&&!G.over&&!repeat) cycleThrow();
  if(code==='KeyT'&&G&&!G.over&&!G.paused&&!repeat&&NET.on&&typeof netAidHold==='function') netAidHold();   // v16.77, his ask: T patches up a teammate in reach with your Bandage or Medkit, the pad Y; T was bound to nothing in a raid (H cycles the legend, X is the ring search)

why: He is playing co-op on one PC and player 2 (his child, on a pad) has no way to put a bandage on player 1. The v16.23 belt path already sends a heal to a teammate, but only from a belt slot, and only while you face him within 0.8 of a radian, which a child on a pad will not manage. The fix reuses that path whole: a press of Y (pad) or T (keyboard) with a teammate within NET_REV_R (facing not needed) calls netAidStart with a Bandage while he is under 85, else a Medkit if carried and he is under full; the item leaves the backpack, the same wind-up runs (startPrep), and at the end the aid word goes to his window, which heals him by its own rules (applyHeal stops a Bandage at 85, a Medkit reaches 100). He needs nothing or you carry nothing: one plain line, nothing spent. With a teammate in reach Y does this instead of holding the ring search; with nobody in reach Y holds keyboard X as today. Decided on the press and latched for the hold, so a held Y starts once and never repeats the refusal every frame. Keyboard: H is taken (it has cycled the key legend since v2.94), X is the ring search, so T, which is bound to nothing in a raid (its only life is a floor station key in the Undercroft) and sits beside R and F. K is the fallback if he prefers a key no table knows. No balance number moves, no TXSHIP sentence is reworded, no player text names boarding, ship, touchdown, hotbar or bag.
